d:
Janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke 'sushasan divas: nitish sanvad' karyakram ko lekar bihar ki rajniti men siyasi para charh gaya hai. rajdhani patna sthit jadyu daphtar se is karyakram ko lekar khas vok-thru (WKT) ke sath hi rashtriy janta dal (RJD) aur JDU ke netaon ki tikhi bayanbaji samne aaee hai.
RJD vidhayak ranvijay sahu ka bayan- 'bihar men khela hoga'
